title: refactor(a2a-server): implement V1 to V2 settings migration logic

triage_metadata.reasoning: The issue is clear, specific, and actionable. It points directly to existing TODO comments in packages/a2a-server/src/config/settings.ts and requests updating the Settings interface and implementing migration logic to support V2 nested settings matching packages/cli/src/config/settings.ts.
triage_metadata.effort_reasoning: The refactor is localized to packages/a2a-server/src/config/settings.ts and its corresponding test file, involving interface updates and straightforward mapping logic for flat V1 to nested V2 settings.

summary.problem: The a2a-server settings interface and loader do not fully support the V2 nested settings structure (e.g., ui.showMemoryUsage, security.folderTrust, context.fileFiltering) and lack migration logic for legacy V1 flat settings.
summary.root_cause: packages/a2a-server/src/config/settings.ts currently uses a flat Settings interface and directly merges settings without converting legacy V1 flat settings into the V2 nested schema structure.
summary.context: Updating packages/a2a-server/src/config/settings.ts aligns a2a-server with the V2 settings schema defined in schemas/settings.schema.json and packages/cli/src/config/settings.ts.

steps: Update the Settings interface in packages/a2a-server/src/config/settings.ts to support the V2 nested settings structure (e.g. ui.showMemoryUsage, security.folderTrust, context.fileFiltering, and other nested categories).

Implement a V1-to-V2 settings migration function in packages/a2a-server/src/config/settings.ts that converts flat legacy V1 settings (such as top-level showMemoryUsage, boolean folderTrust, and top-level fileFiltering) into their nested V2 positions.
Invoke the migration function within loadSettings in packages/a2a-server/src/config/settings.ts when processing loaded configuration objects.

testing_strategy.expected_behavior: loadSettings seamlessly migrates legacy V1 flat settings to the V2 nested format while maintaining full compatibility with V2 settings.
verification_steps: Add unit tests in packages/a2a-server/src/config/settings.test.ts providing legacy V1 flat settings (e.g. showMemoryUsage, folderTrust) and asserting that loadSettings transforms them into V2 nested properties (ui.showMemoryUsage, security.folderTrust.enabled).
Run vitest run packages/a2a-server/src/config/settings.test.ts to verify all unit tests pass.
